Row for the All view.

Includes contact, membership badge, and last class.

CardOnFile.title: CardOnFile
CardOnFile.description:
Saved card details for the paying account.

Only the parent account in a linked family can hold a
card (enforced by the `linked_account_no_stripe` check
constraint on `user_gym_profiles`), so these fields are
surfaced once at the response root rather than per
membership.

CheckinMembershipBreakdown.title: CheckinMembershipBreakdown
CheckinMembershipBreakdown.description:
Usage breakdown for one membership after check-in.

Attributes:
    plan_id: The membership plan.
    plan_type: Trial, one_time, or recurring.
    class_count: Max classes allowed (None = unlimited).
    classes_used: Classes used this cycle (post-checkin).
    classes_remaining: Classes left (None = unlimited).
    is_eligible: Whether this plan covers the checked-in class.

ClassesCheckinRequest.title: ClassesCheckinRequest
ClassesCheckinRequest.description:
Request body for checking a member into a class.

Attributes:
    crm_user_id: The member checking in.
    gym_id: The gym where the class takes place.
    class_id: The class being attended.

ClassesCheckinResponse.title: ClassesCheckinResponse
ClassesCheckinResponse.description:
Response for the check-in endpoint.

Attributes:
    log_id: The newly created log entry. None if check-in
        was not possible.
    chosen_plan_id: The plan that was charged. None if no
        eligible plan with capacity was found.
    memberships: Full breakdown of all active memberships.

CrmMemberStatus.title: CrmMemberStatus

Computed membership status for CRM display.

Extends DB statuses with derived values like trial,
overdue, and no_membership.

    filters: Active filters from the frontend.

    count: Number of rows to fetch per page.

    view: The resolved view (echoed from request).
    filters: The applied filters (echoed from request).
    data: Pre-sorted, pre-filtered, pre-formatted rows.

Charge a member's card for an ad-hoc amount.

Creates a one-off Stripe invoice (outside any subscription)
for ``amount_cents`` with ``reason`` used as both the invoice
description and the invoice item name. ``paid_cash`` routes
the invoice through the out-of-band payment path instead of
charging the card.

detaches every discount currently on the membership.

MemberMembershipsUpdatePriceRequest.description:
Upgrade a membership to its plan's currently active price.

The target price is not caller-supplied: the service
always moves the membership onto the plan's single
``is_active = true`` price. If the membership is already
there the call is a CRM no-op but still re-syncs Stripe.
